info.title: Zladovce API
info.description: API of the Zladovce shop. Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details with a stable `code` and Serbian text. Endpoints under /api/v1/admin require an Amazon Cognito access token. Request members listed as `required` must be sent (a nullable one may be null); a missing member gives 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with the field in `errors`. 409 SLUG_TAKEN and SKU_TAKEN also carry `errors` pointing at the field (`slug`, `sku`, `variants[i].sku`).

get.summary: Liveness: the process is running. Does not touch the database.
Public store settings: name, logo, contact, social links, delivery and shipping, SEO defaults.
Active categories in display order, with the number of visible products.
An active category with its SEO data.
Product grid: visible products with the listing price (lowest variant price) and availability.
get.description: Visible = active, not archived, in an active category, with at least one active variant. Sort `bestselling` is accepted and ordered like `newest` until order data exists. Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

get.summary: Product page: variants with prices and availability (never the exact stock), images, SEO.
Other visible products of the same category (featured first, then newest). `limit` 1–12, default 4.
Live price and availability of variants (for prerendered pages and the cart).
get.description: `variantIds`: up to 100 ids, repeated (`variantIds=a&variantIds=b`) or comma-separated (`variantIds=a,b`). Variants that are not on sale are missing from the result. Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

post.summary: Pre-signed browser upload (multipart POST straight to the storage) for a product or category image.

get.summary: Variants with status `low` or `out` (at or below their low-stock threshold), emptiest first. `limit` 1–100, default 10.
get.description: Same rows as `GET /admin/inventory?status=low,out` (`totalItems` matches); the dashboard card should link there. Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

get.summary: All categories that are not archived, with product counts.

post.summary: Create a category. The slug is generated from the name when not given.
post.description: Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED, INVALID_IMAGE, UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND; 409 SLUG_TAKEN (`errors.slug`), IMAGE_NOT_READY, IMAGE_ALREADY_ATTACHED.

put.summary: Set the display order of all categories.
put.description: Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (must list every non-archived category exactly once).

put.summary: Update a category. Empty slug keeps the current one; `imageKey` null removes the image.
put.description: Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED, INVALID_IMAGE, UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND; 404 NOT_FOUND; 409 SLUG_TAKEN (`errors.slug`), IMAGE_NOT_READY, IMAGE_ALREADY_ATTACHED.

delete.summary: Archive a category. Refused while it has products that are not archived.
delete.description: The category image is removed with it: `image` is cleared in the same save and the image files are deleted afterwards. Errors: 404 NOT_FOUND; 409 CATEGORY_HAS_PRODUCTS.

get.summary: Products with price range, stock summary and main image.

post.summary: Create a product with at least one variant; each variant gets its stock record (and an InitialStock movement when above 0).
post.description: Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (also unknown/archived categoryId); 409 SLUG_TAKEN (`errors.slug`), SKU_TAKEN (`errors.sku` for the product SKU, otherwise one `errors["variants[i].sku"]` per taken variant SKU, i = index in the request).

get.summary: A product (archived ones too) with its variants, stock and images.

put.summary: Update product values. Requires the `version` last read; a stale version gives 409 CONCURRENT_EDIT.
put.description: Replaces every value: all members of the body must be sent. Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED; 404 NOT_FOUND; 409 CONCURRENT_EDIT, SLUG_TAKEN (`errors.slug`), SKU_TAKEN (`errors.sku`), NO_ACTIVE_VARIANT, PRODUCT_ARCHIVED.

post.summary: Archive a product (hidden everywhere, slug and SKU become reusable). Idempotent.

post.description: Errors: 404 NOT_FOUND; 409 SLUG_TAKEN (`errors.slug`), SKU_TAKEN (`errors.sku`) (reused meanwhile), CATEGORY_ARCHIVED.

post.summary: Add a variant with its opening stock. Returns the whole product.
post.description: Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED; 404 NOT_FOUND; 409 SKU_TAKEN (`errors.sku`), PRODUCT_ARCHIVED, CONFLICT (50 variants).

put.summary: Update a variant (stock is changed through the inventory endpoints). Returns the whole product.
put.description: Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED; 404 NOT_FOUND; 409 SKU_TAKEN (`errors.sku`), LAST_ACTIVE_VARIANT, PRODUCT_ARCHIVED.

delete.summary: Archive a variant. Returns the whole product.

post.summary: Attach an uploaded image (key from upload-url). The first image becomes the main image. Returns the whole product.
post.description: Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (key not a product upload key), INVALID_IMAGE, UPLOAD_NOT_FOUND; 404 NOT_FOUND; 409 IMAGE_NOT_READY (processor still running, retry), IMAGE_ALREADY_ATTACHED, IMAGE_LIMIT_REACHED (20), PRODUCT_ARCHIVED.

put.summary: Set the order of all images and the main image (null = first). Returns the whole product.
Change the alt text of an image. Returns the whole product.

delete.summary: Remove an image and its files; the next image becomes main when needed. Returns the whole product.

get.summary: Variants (of products that are not archived) with stock, threshold and status.
get.description: `status`: `ok`, `low`, `out`; several values comma-separated (`status=low,out`) and/or repeated (`status=low&status=out`) match any of them. `status=low,out` returns exactly the rows counted by `GET /admin/dashboard/low-stock` (link the dashboard card there). Errors: 400 VALIDATION_FAILED.

post.summary: Manual stock correction with a mandatory reason. Atomic; stock never goes below zero.

put.summary: Set the low-stock threshold of a variant.

get.summary: Stock movements of a variant, newest first, with the administrator's name.

Bearer.description: Amazon Cognito access token of an administrator (group Owner or Staff).
